New features need to be approved in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please start there for a generic speed column.

Until then, you can build one yourself by extending `ProgressColumn`, as described in [the progress docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/progress.rst). `TransferSpeedColumn` in [rich/progress.py](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py) is a short example to copy.

Related earlier issue: #3835.
